notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping it and untapping Aphetto Alchemist, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Citizen token, adding {W}.
Repeat.
